```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'   # every 6 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout agent connectors repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          ref: main
          path: agent-connectors

      - name: Set branch name
        run: echo "branch=sync-ai-connector-docs-$(date +%s)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create new branch
        run: git checkout -b "$branch"

      - name: Copy connector docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors
          for dir in agent-connectors/*; do
            if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
              connector=$(basename "$dir")
              mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors/"$connector"
              cp "$dir"/*.md docs/ai-agents/connectors/"$connector"/
            fi
          done

      - name: Clean up temporary checkout
        run: rm -rf agent-connectors

      - name: Commit changes if any
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add docs/ai-agents/connectors
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "No changes to commit."
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            git commit -m "Sync AI connector docs"
            git push --set-upstream origin "$branch"
          fi

      - name: Create PR
        if: env.no_changes == 'false'
        uses: airbytehq/octavia-bot@v1
        with:
          title: "Sync AI connector docs"
          body: |
            Automated sync of AI connector documentation from airbyte-agent-connectors.
          head: ${{ env.branch }}
          base: main
          labels: documentation,auto-merge
```
